title: Interim manager
description:
Kariera
  
  
Interim manager
  
  
Stale się rozwijamy, dlatego poszukujemy Interim Managera, który nie będzie stronił od żadnego wyzwania.
  
  
****Czego Poszukujemy Wśród Kandydatów:****
Entuzjazmu dla biznesu, doświadczeń w zarządzaniu wykonawczym, mentoring, doradztwo biznesowe.
  
  

* Min 5 lat doświadczenia w zarządzaniu firmami lub w zarządzaniu tymczasowym/kryzysowym.
* Wysoki poziom umiejętności komunikacyjnych i przywódczych.
* Zasady moralne, etyka, charakter i osobista postawa.
* Silna orientacja na wyniki.
* Gotowość do podróży i dostosowania się do wymagań klienta.

**Czego Oczekujemy Od Ciebie w Zakresie Umiejętności Pracy z Ludźmi?**
Słowami Jednego z Naszych Interim Managerów:
  
  
*"Interim musi być osobowością dojrzałą, z realnym i przeżytym doświadczeniem. Ponadto musi być osobą praktyczną, która na pierwszym miejscu stawia interesy właścicieli oraz zadowolenie klientów i pracowników. Dopiero w następnym kroku rozważa siebie i własne potrzeby."*
****Oferta:****

* Różnorodna praca czasem mocno pompująca adrenalinę.
* Bardzo ciekawa rekompensata finansowa w zależności od wyników.
* Sprawdzone know-how.
* Długotrwałe systematyczne doradztwo i szkolenia.
* Bardzo profesjonalne i poważne podejście.
* Możliwość samorealizacji i rozwoju osobistego.

Jeśli jesteś zainteresowany współpracą, proszę o przesłanie informacji o sobie.
  
  
**Martina Štefková**
*HR Manager*
E-mail: martina.stefkova@jpf.pl
  
  
Telefon: +420 604 559 955

title: Training Specialist - Passenger Services - 12-month Fixed-Term contract
description: Join dnata, a global market leader in ground handling and experience the excitement of working in one of the world’s most dynamic industries!OVERALL PURPOSE OF THE POSITIONJoin dnata as a Training Specialist supporting our Learning & Development team on a 12-month fixed-term contract.At dnata we are dedicated to assisting employees reach professional goals through development opportunities.As the Training Specialist - Passenger Services, you are responsible for providing ongoing training support on an adhoc and hybrid basis. Working closely with the National Training team and local Management and Service Delivery Supervisor Team, this role will ensure that training is facilitated and organised as per business and client airline requirements.Primary Duties And ResponsibilitiesThe role will provide an opportunity for the successful applicant to gain and apply knowledge, skills and experience to perform the following duties:Train colleagues in an efficient and cost-effective way;Liaise with specialist and clients to ensure relevant training and administration resources as used and updated where required;Assist the training team to report on training compliance, expiries and recurrence requirements;Assist the training team to complete sign-off processes and ensure all applicable team members meet company standards;Provide feedback, mentoring and support to buddy’s and SME’sAccountable person for completing paperwork and entering into VETrackAssist with training document control and document reviewAssist other ports with data entry, as required.Assist training department with any ad hoc dutiesEssential CriteriaVETrak experience essentialCurrently or willing to be signed off on numerous Passenger Services Functions including: PAX Assist, Check-in and Delta/Gate SupervisorHigh level of computer literacy and sound knowledge of training management systems.Well-developed communication skills both written and oral and negotiation skills;Sound understanding of the Australian Quality Training Framework and knowledge of all aspects of VET and RTO quality frameworks;Desirable CriteriaPrevious experience in or knowledge of airline industry principles and procedures.Please note that employment with dnata Airport Services Pty. Limited is conditional upon a satisfactory police/security clearance (ASIC).

title: Career Process Association - Night Shift -US Process
description:
**Company Description** 
 V Engineering LLC is a leading staffing organization focused on connecting businesses with the right talent across diverse industries. With more than a decade of experience, the company has built a strong global client and candidate base and maintains a high customer retention rate. Its team of trained professionals uses advanced tools and methods to bridge gaps between employers and job seekers. V Engineering LLC emphasizes a values\-driven work culture and strong ethics, striving to deliver long\-term, successful placements.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Career Process Associate – Night Shift – US Process will work full time on\-site at the Rajarhat office. This role involves supporting candidates through the career process, including understanding their profiles, discussing career paths, and guiding them through application, interview, and onboarding stages. The associate will handle inbound and outbound communication with candidates and clients in the US, provide timely information, and ensure a professional and positive experience. Daily responsibilities include maintaining accurate records, analyzing candidate fit for roles, coordinating with internal teams, and delivering high\-quality customer service during night shift hours. The role also requires adherence to company policies, process guidelines, and performance targets.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Career Counseling and Career Development skills to guide individuals through role selection and growth opportunities.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication abilities, including clear spoken and written English suitable for US\-based clients and candidates.
* Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills to assess candidate profiles, match them with suitable roles, and interpret process\-related data.
* Candidates should possess proven Customer Service skills to manage queries, resolve issues, and maintain a positive experience throughout the staffing process.
* Comfort with night shift work supporting US processes, with the ability to manage time and workload efficiently.
* Basic computer proficiency, including use of CRM or applicant tracking systems, email, and office productivity tools.
* Prior experience in staffing, BPO, recruitment, or counseling is an advantage.
* Minimum educational qualification: bachelor’s degree or equivalent; relevant certifications in counseling or HR are beneficial.
